_doc: Curated MCP connectors offered to the operator in the dashboard. Spec 0029. Adding a new entry here makes it appear under /connectors. The runtime stores connector configuration in the DB after install — this file is the directory, not the source of truth.

secrets.label: Bot Token (xoxb-…)
secrets.help: Create at api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions. Needs scopes: channels:read, channels:history, chat:write, users:read, search:read.

secrets.label: Team ID (T…)
secrets.help: From the Slack workspace URL or `slack:team` in the API tester.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List public channels in the workspace.

tools.name: slack_get_channel_history
tools.description: Fetch recent messages from a channel.

tools.name: slack_get_thread_replies
tools.description: Fetch all replies in a thread.

tools.name: slack_get_user_profile
tools.description: Fetch a user's profile by id.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a channel.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message.

connectors.name: Sentry
connectors.description: Errors, releases, issues across your projects.

secrets.label: Access Token
secrets.help: User Auth Token from sentry.io/settings/account/api/auth-tokens. Recommended scopes: org:read, project:read, event:read, member:read, alerts:read. (The package reads this env as `SENTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN` — different from SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN used by other Sentry SDKs.)

secrets.label: Host
secrets.help: Defaults to sentry.io for the SaaS. Self-hosted Sentry: set to your domain (e.g. sentry.example.com).

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List Sentry organizations the auth token can access.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List recent issues filtered by org/project/query.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Fetch a single issue by short-ID or URL.

tools.name: search_errors
tools.description: Search error events with Sentry's query syntax.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List releases for an organization or project.

tools.name: assign_issue
tools.description: Assign an issue to a user or team.
